title: I Put the Lost-Cat Flyer on the Door They Claimed Wasn't Theirs

parts.text: My cat went missing Tuesday. A neighbor on the building camera in a green beanie scooped her into a stairwell. When I knocked, they said that door wasn't theirs and they didn't have a cat. I was thirty-one, holding a flyer with her white chin. I taped the flyer at eye level on that door, plus the camera still with the beanie. Wednesday the door opened. They said they were "watching her from the street." She ran to me. I took the flyer down and left a card for the humane officer anyway, because watching from the street does not require a stairwell scoop. She slept on my laptop. The beanie did not come to claim credit. Doors that aren't theirs still have tape residue. I can live with residue.

social.video_title: The door that wasn't theirs still had my cat — Part 1/1
social.description: Green beanie on camera, white chin on a flyer, a stairwell scoop. Would you have called animal control first?
